input: Look into becoming a licensed notary public

gold.taskDescription: Research and complete the steps required to obtain a notary public license or commission.

questions.title: Which state or country will you be commissioned in?
questions.description: Notary requirements vary significantly by jurisdiction, so knowing the location is essential for accurate guidance.

questions.title: Have you already looked into your state's specific requirements?
questions.description: Understanding the user's starting point helps determine how much research groundwork still needs to be done.

questions.title: What is your primary reason for becoming a notary?
questions.description: Whether for personal use, employment, or a side business shapes which steps and tools to prioritize.

questions.title: Do you want to offer mobile or remote online notary services?
questions.description: Mobile and remote online notarization require additional steps, tools, and sometimes separate certifications.

questions.title: What is your target date to be fully commissioned?
questions.description: A deadline helps structure the pace and sequencing of the plan's action steps.

questions.title: Do you have a budget set aside for fees and supplies?
questions.description: Costs can include application fees, a bond, training courses, a notary seal, and a journal.

questions.title: Will your employer be sponsoring or supporting this process?
questions.description: Employer involvement may affect reimbursement, required paperwork, and how the commission is registered.
